description: Source code for Bluetooth key management, including key retrieval, storage, and handling functions, with support for key overwriting and settings persistence.

methods.name: bt_keys_get_addr
methods.description: Retrieve or allocate a Bluetooth key structure for a given address and ID, with optional overwriting of oldest keys.

methods.name: bt_foreach_bond
methods.description: Iterate over bonded keys and execute a callback function.

methods.name: bt_keys_foreach_type
methods.description: Iterate over keys of a specific type and execute a callback function.

methods.name: bt_keys_find
methods.description: Find a key matching type, ID, and address.

methods.name: bt_keys_get_type
methods.description: Get or create a key of a specific type, ID, and address.

methods.name: bt_keys_find_irk
methods.description: Find an IRK key matching a given address, considering RPA.

methods.name: bt_keys_find_addr
methods.description: Find a key by address and ID.

methods.name: bt_keys_add_type
methods.description: Add a key type to an existing key.

methods.name: bt_keys_clear
methods.description: Clear a key's data and delete associated settings.

methods.name: bt_keys_store
methods.description: Persist a key to settings storage.

methods.name: id_add
methods.description: Add a key to the ID management system.

methods.name: keys_commit
methods.description: Commit all keys to persistent storage.

methods.name: bt_keys_update_usage
methods.description: Update the usage (aging counter) of a key, with optional persistence.

methods.name: bt_keys_show_sniffer_info
methods.description: Display key information for sniffer logs.
